title: Round 19b: the black box with BBR's bandwidth estimate (arm A4, H6)
description: Round 19's black box aimed its window at 2^u times the guest's 1 s average delivery rate (its 2 s maximum) times the minimum RTT. That average trails a growing window by about 0.5 s, so the window grew 19% per 0.5 s instead of per RTT: it started 2.2 below net1 v6's rule on validation and fell to 3.0 below. Round 19b repeats the raw arm with the measured BDP BBR uses, the kernel's per-ACK delivery rate (tcpi_delivery_rate) at its maximum over the last 2 s times the minimum RTT; everything else is round 19's spec (round 15's copies mixture, tau 1 s, 120 iterations, seeds 1 to 3), so it compares with round 19's truth and net1 arms.
prepare: N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: S="$OUT/spec-r19b-$ARM-s$SEED.json"; jq --arg arm "$ARM" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "ppo" | .base = "fixed" | .inputs = $arm | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .noise_sigma = 0.2 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = 0.0003 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r19b-$ARM-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
